values: How to update the weekly schedule
Enter next week’s classes in the date block for that Monday–Sunday period.
Do not rename monthly tabs, move the TIME SLOT column, or change shala headings.
Use the Workshop or event fill from the legend. Use Shala Rental fill for private rentals.
Check the date range, teachers, and time slots; then publish/share the schedule link.
Teacher names can be separated by commas, /, &, or ‘and’.
Class A. Teacher A / Class B. Teacher B (19:00 - 20:00)
Use only when two sessions share the exact time and space.
